title.zh: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%
title.en: 谷歌Q3财报：云业务暴增103%创纪录，但净利大跌25%致股价盘后跌近10%

current_state.zh: Alphabet's Q3 2026 results showed record Google Cloud growth of 103% to $30.7B driven by enterprise AI infrastructure and TPU demand, but net profit fell about 25% on $8.7B in equity-investment losses and heavy capex pushed free cash flow negative, sending the stock down 9.84% in after-hours trading.
